description: This file is a Python script for generating an address and contact report within the ERPNext system, involving data retrieval and formatting functions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Constructs report column headers based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves address and contact data for specified party.

methods.name: get_party_addresses_and_contact
methods.description: Fetches addresses and contacts for a party, organizing data for report.

methods.name: get_party_details
methods.description: Retrieves detailed address or contact info for a list of parties.

methods.name: add_blank_columns_for
methods.description: Provides blank columns for address or contact fields when data is missing.

methods.name: get_party_group
methods.description: Returns the group name associated with a party type.
